objective: Measure what autonomous GPT-6 Luna/high can accomplish beyond the routine three-failure cutoff, while separating workflow gates from evidence of model limits.

authority.baseline_validation: Supplied by root before case processing; not repeated for this read-only/isolated cohort.
authority.initial_source_write_stop: Corpus grinder closed all seven routine tasks and confirmed no further source/recipe/manifest writes; 10 initial hypothesis compiler invocations, 13 short-budget rounds, one promotion. See recovery/corpus/batch-001/worker-summary.md and new-attempts.jsonl.
authority.single_writer: Production source, recipe, and manifest writes remain with root's sole-writer process. Endurance candidates and receipts are confined to this cohort directory.

sample_method: Purposeful 12-case coverage sample from the frozen batch-001 selection, including observed short-budget failures, two routine cases skipped before compilation, several supervisor-labeled workflow blockers, and two exact controls. It is not a random sample and will not support a repository-wide solvability rate.

budget.compiler_counting_unit: Each invocation of compiler.compile_source, including failures after invocation. Pre-compiler source-closure rejections are recorded separately and do not count as compiler experiments. Promotions, validation compiles, and the earlier short-budget cohort are accounted separately; no endurance candidate is promoted.
budget.quota_rule: Per-case quotas are hard caps. Reallocation requires root approval and a revised sum before the next compile. A case stopped by its quota is budget-censored, not classified as a Luna failure.
budget.repeat_rule: Recompiling a source to check reproducibility consumes a slot. Repeated output identity is not a new effective hypothesis. Source-text variation with already-seen effective object identity does not earn another meaningful-hypothesis number.

required_trial_fields: cohort/case/iteration and meaningful-hypothesis index (separate from raw compiler invocation count)
UTC timestamp, agent/model/reasoning, analysis-level transition and reason for moving or stopping
candidate source path, exact source SHA-256, candidate provenance, and source immutability check
precompile prediction, machine-level consequence, falsifier, discriminating question, and prior outputs compared
pinned compiler profile and exact flags; no other compiler/profile can support a matching claim
compiler receipt and unique output directory; compiler logs and complete object bytes archived
full object SHA-256/size; every emitted segment name/size/SHA-256; selected code size/SHA-256; object declarations, publics, externals, group/segment definitions, all fixups and relocations
effective output identity based on code and complete object semantics (not filesystem timestamps), repeat/equivalence class, and whether it is genuinely new
exact pristine target extent and hash rechecked against the frozen recipe/oracle identity before comparison
strict emitted extent and complete-byte equality as separate results; no normalization used for acceptance
automatic compact match diagnosis and archived full diagnostic from the frozen engine, with engine identity
established fact, ruled-out hypothesis, information gain, remaining material hypotheses, workflow gate versus model limitation, and next evidence
repeat count, unique effective output count, hypothesis number at outcome, remaining case quota, stop reason, and quota-censored/model-exhaustion distinction
per-case analysis-level transitions, including explicit movement above local spelling when warranted
raw token usage separated by model and uncached input, cached input, output/reasoning; no weighted economics without an explicit applicable price schedule

protocol.candidate_location: Only recovery/corpus/endurance-001/<case>/; do not edit active recovery/candidates, source, recipes, manifests, layouts, oracle, engine, or production tools.
protocol.compile_surface: Use tools/compiler.py compile_source with in-memory isolated candidate bytes and pinned profile; each call creates a unique build/probes work directory. Archive input and output into the cohort case directory. Do not call grind.py, prepare_candidate.py, promotion, validation or supervisor-diagnostic to obtain extra attempts.
protocol.evidence_before_trial: Read current context/card, archived compact diagnosis first, mismatch families/residuals and lost anchors; expand frozen-engine full diagnostics only when needed. Record concrete prediction/falsifier before every compiler invocation.
protocol.match_claim: Research exact equality is recorded as a candidate observation only. No production eligibility, strict acceptance, ownership transfer, or promotion is claimed. Any complete exact candidate is held with a receipt for root's serial review.
prohibited: raw bytes, inline assembly or emitted byte directives
fake padding or hidden raw ownership
changing pinned toolchain/profile for an acceptance claim
source writes outside the isolated cohort
assuming SUPERVISOR implies a Luna intelligence ceiling
protocol.workflow_vs_model: Classify precompiler/tool/binding blocks as workflow gates unless evidence shows the isolated intellectual task itself is unsolved. Distinguish unresolved, unsupported by pinned profile, budget-censored, and model-exhausted statuses.
